verses.en: Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
verses.sm: Atua o Isaraelu, ia Moapi, Oi talofa ia Nepo! aua ua faatafunaina ia; ua faamaina Kiriataima, ua aea; ua faamaina Mesekavo, ma ua faamatautia.

verses.en: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
verses.sm: E le toe viia Hesepona e Moapi, ua fai togafiti i latou e malaia ai o ia; ua latou faapea, Ina o mai ia, ia tatou faaumatia O ia, ia le toe fai ma nuu; Matameni e, e fano lava oe; e mulimuli atu le pelu ia te 0e,

verses.en: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
verses.sm: O le leo o le alaga mai Horonaima, o i ai le faatafunaga ma le malaia tele.

verses.en: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
verses.sm: Ua malaia Moapi; ua pa mai le alaga a ona tama iti.

verses.en: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
verses.sm: Aua ua latou o ae lava i le aepa o Luita o fetagisi; o le ifo ai foi mai Horonaima, ua lagona ai e ua ita mai le alaga ina ua malaia.

verses.en: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
verses.sm: Ina sosola ia, ia sao outou, ma ia avea outou e pei o le tula ile vao.

verses.en: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.
verses.sm: Ua e faatuatua i mea ua e faia, ma au oloa, o le mea lea e puea ai lava oe; e alu atu foi Kimosa i le tafeaga, o ana faitaulaga ma ona alii faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.sm: E sau foi le na te faatafunaina i aai uma, e leai se aai e sao; e fano foi le vanu, e faaumatia foi le eleele laugatasi, aua ua fetalai mai ai le AL.

verses.en: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
verses.sm: la fai ni apaau mo Moapi, ina ia lele o ia ma alu ese; aua e fai ma faatafunaga ona aai, e leai se nofo ai.

verses.en: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
verses.sm: la faafanoina le na te faia le galuega a le ALII ma le faavaivai, ia faafanoina le ua taofia lana pelu ai le toto.

verses.en: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
verses.sm: Ua nofo filemu Moapi talu ina o taulealea o ia, ua nofo o ia i luga o lona ‘alu, e lei fesaaa‘iina o ia ai lea ipu i lea ipu, c lei alu foi o ia i se tafeaga; o le mea lea ua tumau ai lona nanamu, ua le liua lona manogi.

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
verses.sm: O le mea lea faauta, e oo ai i ona po, ua fetalai mai le ALII, ou te aauina atu ai ia te ia nisi latou te faataoto ia te ia, ma sasaa ai ana ipu, ma taei i ana fagu.

verses.en: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth-el their confidence.
verses.sm: E ma foi Moapi ia Kimosa, e pei ona ma o le aiga o Isaraelu ia Peteli, o lo latou faatuatuaga.

verses.en: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
verses.sm: Pe faapefea ona outou fai mai, O toa i matou, o tagata malolosi e tau ai le taua?

verses.en: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
verses.sm: Ua faatafunaina Moapi, ma ua o ae ona‘aai; o ona taulelea foi na filifilia ua o ifo i latou ia fasiotia, o loo fetalai mai ai le Tupu, o le ALII o ‘au lona suafa.

verses.en: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
verses.sm: O le malaia o Moapi ua latalata ona oo mai, o le mea foi e leaga ai o ia e vave mai lava lea.

verses.en: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
verses.sm: O outou uma o e vagavagai ia te ia, ia outou faanoanoa ona o ia; o outou uma foi o e iloa lona igoa, ia outou faapea atu, E! ua gausia le tootoo malosi, o le laau matagofie.

verses.en: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.
verses.sm: O oe na le tama fafine ua nofo i Tipona, ina alu ifo ia ai le mamalu, ma nofo i le nuu naumati; aua e alu ae ia te oe le faatafunaina Moapi, na te faaumatia ou “olo.

verses.en: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?
verses.sm: O oe na ua nofo i Aroeru, ia e tu i le ala, ma vaai atu; fesili atu i le ua sola, ma le ua sao, ia faapea atu, Po o le a ea le mea ua fai?

verses.en: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
verses.sm: Ua faamaina Moapi; aua ua lafoia o ia; ina uio ia outou ma alalaga; ina ta‘uina atu i Arinona, ua faatafunaina Moapi,

verses.en: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
verses.sm: ua oo foi le sala i le eleele laugatasi ; o Holona, ma laesa, ma Mefata,

verses.en: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,
verses.sm: ma Tipona, ma Nepo, ma Petetipelata,

verses.en: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,
verses.sm: ma Kiriataima, ma Petekamulo, ma Petemeona,

verses.en: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
verses.sm: ma Kiriota, ma Posara, ma aai uma i le nuu o Moapi, e ua mamao, ma e ua lata mai.

verses.en: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua vavaeeseina le nifo o Moapi, ma lona lima ua gausia, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the LORD: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
verses.sm: la outou faainu ia te ia ia ona; aua ua ia faamaualuga i le ALII; e taafili Moapi i lona puaiga, e fai lava o ia ma tauemuga.

verses.en: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.
verses.sm: E lei faia ea Isaraelu ma tauemuga ia te oe? na maua ea o ia faatasi ma tagata gaoi? auá e iloga ona e tautala ia te ia, ua e lialiai lou ulu.

verses.en: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.
verses.sm: O outou o e nonofo i Moapi, ia outou tuua aai, ma outou mau i le papa; ia pei o le lupe foi outou, o le ua fai lona ofaga i itu o le gutu o le lua.

verses.en: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
verses.sm: Ua matou faalogo i le faamaualuga э Moapi, o lona matuá faamaualuga ma lona faasausili, ma lona faasiasia, ma lona faamaualuga, ma le faafefeteina o lona loto.

verses.en: I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
verses.sm: O loo fetalai mai le Ar, O au ne: ua ou iloa lona ita, a e faatauvaa lava; o ana mea faatauvaa e le faia lava ia.

verses.en: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te nio ai ona o Moapi, ma ou alaga ona o Moapi uma; e oi o ia ona o tagata o Kiriaresa.

verses.en: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.
verses.sm: Le vine e o Sepema, ou te tagi ona o oe ma le tagi o lasaru; ua sopoia le sami e ou moemoe, ua 00 atu i le sami o lasaru; ua osofia e le na te faatafunaina ou fua otata, ma lou taugávine.

verses.en: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
verses.sm: Ua aveesea le fiafia ma le olioli i le fanua lafulemu, O le nuu c Moapi lea; ua ou faaiuina le uaina i le soligavine; e le solia ma le alaga fiafia; o le alaga fiafia e le se alaga fiafia lea.

verses.en: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
verses.sm: Ona o le alaga a Hesepona ua latou fevalaauai e oo : Eleale, e oo lava i laesa, e afua mai i Soara e co i Horonaima, O le povi fafine ua tolu ona tausaga; aua ua avea le vai o Nimara lava ma nca naumati.

verses.en: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai ta; le ALII, ou te faaumatia i Moapi, lé fai tawada i le mea maualuga, ma lè faamu mea manogi i ona atua.

verses.en: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e tagi ai loʻu loto e pei o fagufagu ona 0 Moapi, e tagi ai foi lo‘u loto e pei o fagufagu ona o tagata o Kiriaresa; auā o le tele o mea na na maua ua fano.

verses.en: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
verses.sm: Aua ua selemamaina © latou ulu uma, ma ua sala ‘ava uma; ua selei foi lima uma, ua fusia sulugatiti i ie talatala.

verses.en: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: E pa le lauaitu i luga o fale uma i Moapi, ma ona malae uma; aua ua ou nutililiia Moapi, e pei o se ipu e le fiafia i ai, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
verses.sm: Latou te uio e faapea, E! ua faatafunaina o ia. E! ua liutuaina Moapi ma le ma. E fai foi Moapi ma tauemuga ma mea e matatau ai ia te i latou i ona itu uma.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
verses.sm: Aua o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Faauta, e lele: o ia e pei o le aeto ma falò ona apaau i luga o Moapi.

verses.en: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.sm: Ua aea Kiriota, ua maua foi ‘olo, e avea loto o toa o Moapi i lea lava aso e pei o le loto o le fafine ua faatiga.

verses.en: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the LORD.
verses.sm: E faaumatia Moapi, e le fai ma nuu, aua na ia faamaualuga i le ALII.

verses.en: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: E ia te oe lē nofo i Moapi, le mataʻu, ma le lua, ma le mailei, ua fetalai mai ai le Aw.

verses.en: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O le ua sola i le mataʻu e pau ia i le lua; o le ua alu ae ai le lua e lavea o ia i le mailei; auā ou te faaoo ia Moapi lava le tausaga e tauia mai ai i latou, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
verses.sm: O i latou na sosola, ua latou tutu i le paolo o Hesepona, ua leai so latou malosi; a ua alu atu le afi ai Hesepona, ma le afi mumú mai totonu o Sekono, ua mu ai le itu o Moapi, ma le tumuai o tagata vavao.

verses.en: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
verses.sm: Moapi e, oi talofa ia te oe! ua faaumatia le nuu o Kimosa; aua ua avea ou atalii i le tafeaga, ma ou afafine i le tafeaga.

verses.en: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.sm: A e peitai ou te faafoisia le tafeaga a Moapi i ona po amuli, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII. Ona gata lea o le faasalaina o
